entries.title: Matthew 26:1
segments: Now it happened that after Jesus had finished all these discourses, he said to his disciples,

entries.title: Matthew 26:2
segments: "You know that the Passover is coming in two days, and the Son of man will be delivered up to be crucified."

entries.title: Matthew 26:3
segments: Then the chief priests and the elders of the people met together in the court of the palace of the high priest who was called Caiaphas,

entries.title: Matthew 26:4
segments: and they plotted together to get Jesus into their power by a trick, and to put him to death;

entries.title: Matthew 26:5
segments: but said they, "Not during the feast, for fear of causing a riot among the people."

entries.title: Matthew 26:6
segments: While Jesus was staying in Bethany, in the house of Simon the Leper,

entries.title: Matthew 26:7
segments: a woman came up to him who had an alabaster vase of very costly perfume, and poured it over his head, as he reclined at table.

entries.title: Matthew 26:8
segments: when the disciples saw it, they were indignant, and exclaimed:

entries.title: Matthew 26:9
segments: "Why is this waste? This perfume could have been sold for a good sum, and the money given to the poor."

entries.title: Matthew 26:10
segments: But when Jesus understood it he said to them: "Why are you annoying the woman? This is a beautiful deed she has done for me;

entries.title: Matthew 26:11
segments: "for the poor you have with you always, but me you will not always have.

entries.title: Matthew 26:12
segments: "In pouring this perfume on my body, she was preparing me for my burial.

entries.title: Matthew 26:13
segments: "In solemn truth I tell you that wherever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, what she has done shall be told about, as her memorial."

entries.title: Matthew 26:14
segments: It was then that one of the Twelve, he who was called Judas Iscariot,

entries.title: Matthew 26:15
segments: went to the chief priests and said, "What are you ready to give me for betraying him to you?" So they weighed him thirty pieces of silver;

entries.title: Matthew 26:16
segments: and from that time he kept looking for a chance to betray him.

entries.title: Matthew 26:17
segments: On the first day of the feast of Unleavened Bread, the disciples came to Jesus and said, "Where do you want us to make preparation for you to eat the Passover?"

entries.title: Matthew 26:18
segments: "Go into the city," he answered, "to a certain man, and tell him: "'The Teacher says: "My time is near. I am going to keep the Passover at your house, with my disciples."'"

entries.title: Matthew 26:19
segments: The disciples did as Jesus told them, and made ready the Passover.

entries.title: Matthew 26:20
segments: When evening came he reclined at table with the Twelve;

entries.title: Matthew 26:21
segments: and as they were eating, he said to them, "In solemn truth I tell you that one of you is going to betray me!"

entries.title: Matthew 26:22
segments: In deep distress they began to ask him, each in turn, "It is not I, is it, Master?"

entries.title: Matthew 26:23
segments: In reply he said: "One who has dipped his hand with me in the dish will betray me.

entries.title: Matthew 26:24
segments: "The Son of man is indeed to go as it is written concerning him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of man shall be betrayed. It were good for that man if he had never been born."

entries.title: Matthew 26:25
segments: In answer, Judas, who betrayed him, said, "Surely it is not I, Rabbi?" He said to him, "Is it not?"

entries.title: Matthew 26:26
segments: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread and, when he had blessed it, he broke it and gave to his disciples, saying, "Take, eat, this is my body."

entries.title: Matthew 26:27
segments: And when he had taken the cup and given thanks, he gave it to them, saying:

entries.title: Matthew 26:28
segments: "Drink from it, all of you; for this is my blood of the Covenant, which is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins.

entries.title: Matthew 26:29
segments: "But I say to you, I will never again drink of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in the kingdom of my Father."

entries.title: Matthew 26:30
segments: So after singing a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

entries.title: Matthew 26:31
segments: Then Jesus said to them: "This very night even you will all stumble and fall away from me; for it is written, "I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.

entries.title: Matthew 26:32
segments: But after I am raised up I will go before you into Galilee."

entries.title: Matthew 26:33
segments: "If they all stumble and fall away from you," answered Peter, "I will never do so!"

entries.title: Matthew 26:34
segments: Jesus said to him, "In solemn truth I tell you that on this very night, before cockcrow, you will deny me three times!"

entries.title: Matthew 26:35
segments: But Peter said to him, "Even if I must die with you, I will never deny you." And so said all the disciples.

entries.title: Matthew 26:36
segments: Then Jesus went with them to a place called Gethsemane, and said to his disciples, "Sit down here, while I go and pray yonder."

entries.title: Matthew 26:37
segments: And he took Peter and the two sons of Zebedee with him, and began to be in anguish and sore distress,

entries.title: Matthew 26:38
segments: and he said to them: "My soul is an anguish, even unto death! Stay here, and keep watch with me."

entries.title: Matthew 26:39
segments: Then he went forward a short distance, and fell on his face and prayed: "O, my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me; nevertheless, not as I will, but as You wilt."

entries.title: Matthew 26:40
segments: Then he came to his disciples, and found them asleep, and said to Peter: "So you were none of you strong enough to watch with me even one hour!

entries.title: Matthew 26:41
segments: "Watch and pray that you may not enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak."

entries.title: Matthew 26:42
segments: Then he went away again a second time and prayed, saying, "O, my Father, if this cup cannot pass except I drink it, Your will be done."

entries.title: Matthew 26:43
segments: He came again and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.

entries.title: Matthew 26:44
segments: So he left them and went away again, and prayed the third time in the same words as before.

entries.title: Matthew 26:45
segments: Then he came to the disciples and said: "Sleep on now, and take your rest. Look! the hour is at hand; the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of wicked men.

entries.title: Matthew 26:46
segments: "Rouse yourselves! Let us go. My betrayer is close at hand!"

entries.title: Matthew 26:47
segments: Barely had he spoken these words when Judas, one of the Twelve, appeared, accompanied by a great crowd of men with swords and staves, from the chief priests and elders of the people.

entries.title: Matthew 26:48
segments: Now his betrayer had given them a sign, saying: "Whoever I kiss is the man; arrest him."

entries.title: Matthew 26:49
segments: So he came straight up to Jesus and said, "Hail, Rabbi!" and kissed him eagerly.

entries.title: Matthew 26:50
segments: "Friend, do that for which you came," said Jesus. Then they came forward and laid hands on Jesus, and arrested him.

entries.title: Matthew 26:51
segments: And, behold, one of these who were with Jesus stretched out his hand and drew his sword, and smote the slave of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

entries.title: Matthew 26:52
segments: Then Jesus said to him: "Put back your sword into its place! for all who take the sword will perish by the sword.

entries.title: Matthew 26:53
segments: "Do you not suppose that I am able to appeal to my Father to furnish me at this very moment with twelve legions of angels?

entries.title: Matthew 26:54
segments: "But if I did, how could the Scriptures be fulfilled that say that thus it must happen?"

entries.title: Matthew 26:55
segments: Then Jesus said to the crowds: "Are you come out as against a robber, with swords and staves to arrest me? Day after day, I sat in the temple courts teaching, and you did not apprehend me.

entries.title: Matthew 26:56
segments: "But all this has happened in order that the Scriptures might be fulfilled."

entries.title: Matthew 26:57
segments: Then all his disciples forsook him and fled; but those who had apprehended Jesus led him away to Caiaphas, the high priest, where the scribes and the elders had assembled.

entries.title: Matthew 26:58
segments: Now Peter was following him, afar off, as far as the courtyard of the high priest; and when he got in, he was sitting with the officers, to see the end.

entries.title: Matthew 26:59
segments: And the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were trying to get false evidence against Jesus, in order that they might have him executed;

entries.title: Matthew 26:60
segments: but they found none, although many false witnesses came forward.

entries.title: Matthew 26:61
segments: However, at last two came forward who said, "This fellow declared, 'I can destroy the Temple of God and build it in three days.'"

entries.title: Matthew 26:62
segments: Rising to his feet the high priest asked Jesus: "Do you make no answer? What is it that these are testifying against you?"

entries.title: Matthew 26:63
segments: But Jesus kept silence. Again the high priest addressed him, "I adjure you by the Living God, tell us if you are the Christ, the Son of God!"

entries.title: Matthew 26:64
segments: "I am He," Jesus answered; "yet I tell you that from this time on you will see the Son of man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming upon the clouds of heaven."

entries.title: Matthew 26:65
segments: Then the high priest tore his garments, saying: "He has spoken blasphemy! What further need have we of witnesses? For behold, now you have heard his blasphemy!

entries.title: Matthew 26:66
segments: "What is your verdict?" "He ought to die," they answered.

entries.title: Matthew 26:67
segments: Then did they spit in his face, and buffeted him; and some struck him with the palms of their hands, and cried:

entries.title: Matthew 26:68
segments: "Prophesy to us, you Christ! Who is it who struck you?"

entries.title: Matthew 26:69
segments: Now Peter was sitting outside in the courtyard, and one of the maidservants came up to him and said, "You also were with Jesus, the Galilean!"

entries.title: Matthew 26:70
segments: But he denied it before them all; "I do not know what you mean," he said.

entries.title: Matthew 26:71
segments: Soon afterward he went out into the porch, and another maid saw him, and said to those who were there, "This fellow certainly was with Jesus, the Nazarene!"

entries.title: Matthew 26:72
segments: And again he denied it with an oath, saying, "I never knew the man."

entries.title: Matthew 26:73
segments: A little later the bystanders came up and said to Peter, "You also are certainly one of them, for your speech betrays you."

entries.title: Matthew 26:74
segments: Then he began to curse and swear, saying, "I never knew the man." Immediately the cock crew!

entries.title: Matthew 26:75
segments: Then Peter recalled the word that Jesus had spoken, "Before the cock crow, you shall three times deny me"--and he went out and broke out into bitter weeping.
